title: Travel Starter
description: Short A2 travel vocabulary for checking dictionary switching.

words.exampleEn: Please show your boarding pass at the gate.
words.exampleRu: Пожалуйста, покажите посадочный талон у выхода.

words.exampleEn: The flight has a short delay.
My luggage is still at the airport.
words.exampleRu: Мой багаж всё ещё в аэропорту.

words.exampleEn: I have a reservation for two nights.
words.exampleRu: У меня бронирование на две ночи.

words.exampleEn: Could I have a receipt, please?
The train leaves from platform five.
The museum entrance is on the left.
What currency do you use here?
Check the departure time on the screen.
I need a single ticket to the city center.
words.exampleRu: Мне нужен билет в одну сторону до центра города.
